import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]) -> dict[str, "pd.DataFrame"]:
    postings = inputs["postings"].copy()

    # Reproduce cursor order: ORDER BY account_id, post_date, post_seq
    postings_sorted = postings.sort_values(
        ["account_id", "post_date", "post_seq"], kind="mergesort"
    ).reset_index(drop=True)

    qty = postings_sorted["qty"]
    price = postings_sorted["unit_price"]

    # Validity predicate matching the TRY block condition
    valid = qty.notna() & (qty > 0) & price.notna() & (price >= 0)

    postings_sorted["valid"] = valid
    postings_sorted["post_value"] = qty * price

    # Only valid rows are posted; running total accumulates per account
    # only over valid rows, in the cursor's row order.
    valid_rows = postings_sorted[postings_sorted["valid"]].copy()
    valid_rows["running_total"] = valid_rows.groupby("account_id")["post_value"].cumsum()

    posted_totals = valid_rows[
        ["account_id", "post_seq", "post_date", "post_value", "running_total"]
    ].reset_index(drop=True)

    # Reject counts: every account encountered gets a row, including 0 rejects.
    reject_counts = (
        postings_sorted.groupby("account_id", sort=True)["valid"]
        .apply(lambda s: int((~s).sum()))
        .reset_index()
    )
    reject_counts.columns = ["account_id", "reject_count"]
    reject_counts["reject_count"] = reject_counts["reject_count"].astype(int)

    return {
        "posted_totals": posted_totals,
        "reject_counts": reject_counts,
    }
